question: Will Apple announce a chip with 1TB+ unified memory by Aug 1, 2027 (UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Apple makes an official public announcement — via a product launch event, press release, or Apple.com product listing — of a chip with a unified memory configuration of 1 terabyte (1,024 GB) or greater, on or before August 1, 2027 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if no such official Apple announcement has been made by August 1, 2027 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Announcement" means Apple has publicly revealed the chip and its memory specification through official Apple channels; a rumor, leak, or third-party report does not qualify. The chip may be announced as upcoming or available; it does not need to have shipped by the deadline.
- The 1T+ threshold refers to unified memory capacity (i.e., the total unified memory addressable by the chip), not memory bandwidth or any other metric.
